chart.note_rule: How many + PLURAL noun + do you + verb? Answer with a NUMBER — not Yes or No!
chart.note_exception: The noun after 'How many' must be PLURAL (add -s or -es).
chart.note_exception_detail: How many panda do you see? ❌   How many pandas do you see? ✅

explanation.title: How many
explanation.body: Use 'How many' for countable nouns. 'How much' is for uncountable nouns.

stem: The noun after 'How many' must be...

explanation.title: Plural noun
explanation.body: How many + PLURAL noun. Add -s: How many cats, books, languages, sports.

stem: How many sports do you play?
→ Leo plays soccer, tennis and basketball.

explanation.title: Count and answer
explanation.body: Soccer + Tennis + Basketball = 3 sports. I play three sports.
